name: Wind Transition
description: The second clip blows in over the first with a ragged, randomly offset edge. `direction` picks where the wind comes from. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: 0 = hlwind (rows, the edge enters from the left), 1 = hrwind (from the right), 2 = vuwind (columns, from the top), 3 = vdwind (from the bottom)
